notes_for_editor: Existence and purpose rest on one OpenStreetMap way (height 12, tower:type observation, source Bing, last edited almost two years ago). No build date, design, staffing or fire history found in the sources read, and the NHLR and FFLOS caches have no New York entry under this name. The island is privately owned, so the tower should be treated as private. Coordinates were not checked against the island's outline; worth a human look, including whether the record should be marked unverified or hidden. Other structures on the island (lighthouse and Fort Tyler on Gardiners Point Island) are different and not cited here.
